evidence: Labels 'Windows' and 'Build system'; modifies CMakeLists.txt, CI scripts, and toolchain configurations to migrate Windows native builds to clang-cl.
rationale: Migrating native Windows builds from MSVC to clang-cl resolves recurring compiler bugs and reduces maintenance friction. The description notes MSVC causes persistent issues like internal compiler errors (#31456), lacks inline assembly support, and produces slower builds, with clang-cl also unblocking future optimizations.
